title: Unparalleled selectivity and electronic structure of heterometallic [LnLn'Ln] molecules as 3-qubit quantum gates

synthesis.procedure: A light-brown pyridine solution of H2LA (10.2 mg, 0.032 mmol) and H2LB (14.8 mg, 0.032 mmol) in pyridine (10 mL) was added dropwise with stirring to a colorless pyridine solution (10 mL) of Pr(NO3)3·6H2O (7 mg, 0.016 mmol), Er(NO3)3·5H2O (14.2 mg, 0.032 mmol) and CuCl2·2H2O (2.7 mg, 0.016 mmol; one equivalent relative to Pr). The green solution was stirred for 1 h and layered with hexane. Green crystals of [Cu(py)4(NO3)2] formed after about one week; after about one month, large crystals of 1 (described as yellow in the main text and orange in the SI) were separated manually. The main text states that equal molar amounts of H2LA and H2LB react in pyridine with stoichiometric Er(NO3)3 and Pr(NO3)3, and that CuCl2 modulates assembly/crystallization rather than entering the cluster.
synthesis.time: stirred 1 h; crystals of 1 after about one month
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution reaction followed by hexane layering/diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Hexane layered onto the pyridine reaction mixture; green [Cu(py)4(NO3)2] separated manually from crystals of 1.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows nearly uncoupled Er(III) and Pr(III) ions that behave as two-level systems at low temperature, with chiT close to the free-ion value, weak intramolecular exchange, and EPR g-values distinct for Er and Pr. Pulsed EPR gives phase-memory times up to 0.64 ms and coherent Rabi control, supporting its use as an addressable three-qubit spin system.
